<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device" version="24.7.17">
 
 
 <diagram id="data-and-privacy" name="03 Data and privacy">
 <mxGraphModel dx="1400" dy="1120" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1440" pageHeight="1120" background="#FFFFFF" adaptiveColors="auto">
 <root>
 <mxCell id="0"/>
 <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
 <mxCell id="number" value="<b>03</b>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#172B4D;strokeColor=#172B4D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=20;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=ellipse;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="34" width="52" height="52"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="title" value="Keep evidence. Keep personal inputs in session." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=30;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=1;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="110" y="26" width="1040" height="44"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="subtitle" value="SQLite stores validated public records and three reviewed preferences · personal requests stay volatile" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="110" y="75" width="1180" height="28"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="status" value="TARGET MVP · PLANNED" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;fontStyle=1;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1110" y="28" width="280" height="32"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="public" value="01 PUBLIC EVIDENCE / VALIDATE BEFORE COMMIT" style="swimlane;startSize=34;horizontal=1;rounded=1;arcSize=8;container=1;collapsible=0;pointerEvents=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#EAF7F2;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D7E0EC;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#52657D;align=left;spacingLeft=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="145" width="1360" height="235"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="facts" value="<b>Permitted evidence</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">API + manual imports<br>Products · reviews · verified rules</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=document;size=0.12;spacingBottom=18;" vertex="1" parent="public">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="65" width="260" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="intake" value="<b>Validate intake</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Source registry · Pydantic<br>Stable product + variant IDs</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="public">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="370" y="65" width="260" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="repository" value="<b>Repository boundary</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Transactions · migrations<br>Evidence history + conflict status</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="public">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="710" y="65" width="260" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="evidence" value="<b>Public evidence store</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Facts · rules · provenance<br>Validated public extractions</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=cylinder3;size=14;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;" vertex="1" parent="public">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1060" y="55" width="270" height="110"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="public-note" value="Preserve last-valid facts on failure. Cache keys include evidence hashes and model / prompt / schema versions. Rules need exact references and domain review." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="public">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="185" width="1310" height="28"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="facts-intake" value="source data" edge="1" parent="public" source="facts" target="intake" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="intake-repo" value="validated" edge="1" parent="public" source="intake" target="repository" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="repo-evidence" value="commit" edge="1" parent="public" source="repository" target="evidence" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="preferences" value="02 PREFERENCE MEMORY / EXPLICIT OPT-IN + REVIEWED SAVE" style="swimlane;startSize=34;horizontal=1;rounded=1;arcSize=8;container=1;collapsible=0;pointerEvents=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#F8FAFD;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D7E0EC;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#52657D;align=left;spacingLeft=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="425" width="1360" height="235"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="save" value="<b>Review preferences</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">User opts in, reviews and saves<br>Enabling memory alone is insufficient</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="preferences">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="65" width="260" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="confirmation" value="<b>Confirm save action</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Controller-issued confirmation<br>Model claims of consent rejected</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="preferences">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="370" y="65" width="260" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="allowlist" value="<b>Enforce field allowlist</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Repository validates keys + values<br>Failed write keeps previous values</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=process;size=0.04;" vertex="1" parent="preferences">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="710" y="65" width="260" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="prefs" value="<b>Saved preferences</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Currency · country · product finish<br>INR / India only in this MVP</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=cylinder3;size=14;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;" vertex="1" parent="preferences">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1060" y="55" width="270" height="110"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="preferences-note" value="Reuse as visible defaults; current requests take precedence. Delete / disable memory removes saved values and prevents restoration from caches or logs." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="preferences">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="185" width="1310" height="28"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="save-confirmation" value="user action" edge="1" parent="preferences" source="save" target="confirmation" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="confirmation-allowlist" value="confirmed" edge="1" parent="preferences" source="confirmation" target="allowlist" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="allowlist-prefs" value="save" edge="1" parent="preferences" source="allowlist" target="prefs" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="volatile" value="03 SESSION STATE / NO SENSITIVE PERSISTENCE" style="swimlane;startSize=34;horizontal=1;rounded=1;arcSize=8;container=1;collapsible=0;pointerEvents=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#FFF5DF;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D7E0EC;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#52657D;align=left;spacingLeft=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="705" width="1360" height="165"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="sensitive" value="<b>Personal request + results</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Budget · skin type · exclusions · raw conversation<br>Personal ingredient matches + explanations</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DF;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="volatile">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="60" width="440" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="run" value="<b>Controller + run context</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Typed state · cancellation · request version<br>Raw durable checkpoints disabled</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="volatile">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="580" y="60" width="350" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="reset" value="<b>Clear current session</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Remove sensitive inputs<br>and active result state</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DF;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="volatile">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1040" y="60" width="290" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="sensitive-run" value="in memory" edge="1" parent="volatile" source="sensitive" target="run" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;startArrow=blockThin;startFill=1;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="trust" value="<b>Untrusted content</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Source text and model output cannot grant tools,<br>change destinations or override rules / ranking.<br>No database, shell or arbitrary HTTP for models.</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F2EDFC;strokeColor=#9270BE;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="910" width="420" height="110"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="events" value="<b>Redacted events + usage</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Allowlisted fields: versions, status, tokens, timing.<br>Unknown usage stays unknown.<br>No raw prompts, budgets or personal findings.</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="510" y="910" width="420" height="110"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="export" value="<b>Evaluation reports</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Markdown / JSON exports · PRD 09<br>Replay: public evidence + synthetic profiles.<br>Real sensitive conversations are never replay data.</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=document;size=0.12;spacingBottom=18;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="980" y="910" width="420" height="110"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="logical" value="Storage symbols describe logical record groups within one local SQLite database. Public artifacts and redacted events also pass repository validation." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="1040" width="1360" height="24"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="source-note" value="TR-06–08, 10, 17–21, 25–27 / PRDs 01–04, 08–09 / Target design; the runnable app is currently a development preview." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=12;fontColor=#52657D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="1080" width="1360" height="24"/>
 </mxCell>
 </root>
 </mxGraphModel>
 </diagram>
</mxfile>
